original_problem:
Let
$A=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 0 \\ 1 & -1 \\ 1 & 3 \\ 1 & 5\end{bmatrix}$
and
$B=\begin{bmatrix}-2 & 1 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 0 & 3 & 9\end{bmatrix}.$
What are the dimensions of $BA?$
original_solution:
We notice that $A$ is a $3\times 2$ matrix and $B$ is a $2\times 4$ matrix. 

There are $4$ columns in $B$ and $4$ rows in $A.$ Since the number of columns in $B$ equals the number of rows in $A,$ the matrices $B$ and $A$ are conformable for multiplication. 

The product $BA$ has dimensions $2\times 2:$

$$
{B}_{2\times \boxed{\text{4}}}{\times }_{✓}{A}_{\boxed{\text{4}}\times 2}={BA}_{2\times 2}
$$
